title: Miss Avalon Fishing Fleet

services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: Fishing Camps are a wonderful and knowledgeable experience for all ages 8 and up, come join the crew of the Avalon Lady for a week of crabbing and fishing fun. Learning basic knot tying, how to use spinning and boat fishing rods. Spend 2 evenings fish-ing the back bays. Then you will spend 2 evenings crabbing and learning how to bait and set up 3 types of crab traps. Captain Brandon will teach you to clean your catch, while on the boat he will point out basic navigation and boat safety skills. This is a fun way to spend 4 evenings on the water Fishing and Crabbing! Camps are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday evenings. services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Our nature sunset cruises are timed perfectly to coincide with our local wildlife's active flight and feeding times. Join our crew on a coastal adventure. Tour around Cedar Island past beautiful waterfront homes as we venture into the Atlantic Ocean to look for dolphins and sea birds. As the sun sets, watch for the sneaky sea otter or the black-crowned night heron. Enjoy family fun, and hear a few interesting local facts and history of the 7 Mile Island. We have a large shell and bone collection we share with everyone. Our sunset cruises are a fun & exciting trip for families of all sizes! Become an honorary skipper of the Miss Avalon.
